findings.dataRule: Free Zen models may retain or train on prompts (Zen terms not verified). Send code, tests and docs only. Probe 2026-10-15: opencode.json read denies are enforced for the read tool (relative and absolute paths), but a grep returned the contents of denied files, and a shell command can read them too. So the denies are a guardrail, not a data barrier. Physical separation helps: data/omniswim.db, data/meets.json, data/backups, data/swimcloud-captures and the pairing token are untracked, so a child worktree does not contain them. These tracked files DO reach a child worktree: data/rosters (1), data/training (2), hsuroster26-27.txt, oburoster202627.txt, possible_hsu_scoringteam2627.txt. Failing tests print swimmer names and times. Keep briefs narrow and run only targeted tests that do not read those files.
